scope.title: Scope comes first
scope.body: The selected facility and your role decide what you can see. Group users can switch only among their own organization's facilities.

urgency.title: Colour means urgency
urgency.body: Red needs immediate attention, amber needs review, blue is in progress, and green is safe or complete. Text always states the same meaning.

status.title: Status tells you what is legal next
status.body: Buttons appear only for valid state transitions. A missing action usually means another role must complete its hand-off first.

evidence.title: Evidence sits beside the decision
evidence.body: Forecast confidence, compatibility, custody, freshness, and audit history remain visible where you act.

safety.human: Recommendations never release or move blood automatically; an authorized person must approve the action.
safety.scope: Every operational read and write is restricted to the signed-in organization and permitted facility.
safety.audit: Clinical decisions, custody changes, and controlled overrides record an accountable actor and timestamp.
safety.synthetic: This hackathon release uses realistic synthetic data and a fixed scenario clock, never live hospital records.

issuable.definition: Screening passed, within expiry, in valid storage, and not already reserved or used.

quarantine.definition: Held away from clinical use until required testing or review is complete.

fefo.definition: First expiry, first out: use the safe compatible unit with the shortest remaining life first.

crossmatch.definition: Laboratory confirmation that a selected unit is compatible with the patient requirement.

cover.definition: How long current usable stock is expected to last at forecast demand.

intervals.definition: Low, central, and high demand estimates; the range makes forecast uncertainty visible.

phlebotomist.mission: Guide each donor safely from identification through eligibility and collection, then hand a correctly labelled quarantined bag to the laboratory.
phlebotomist.handoff: The laboratory receives the bag in quarantine. It cannot become available stock until testing and independent release are complete.

lab_technologist.mission: Protect the blood supply by testing quarantined donations, completing independent release, and preparing viable components before their windows close.
lab_technologist.handoff: Released components enter controlled storage. Clinical staff can see them only when screening, expiry, and storage rules permit issue.

blood_bank_officer.mission: Keep donor, laboratory, inventory, and patient work moving as one traceable vein-to-vein service, with exceptions handled before they become delays.
blood_bank_officer.handoff: Network recommendations support your decision, but approval, compatibility, custody, issue, and outcome remain accountable human actions.

rbc_coordinator.mission: Turn network-wide shortage and expiry signals into timely, governed action across the facilities you coordinate.
rbc_coordinator.handoff: A recommendation becomes movement only after source approval, named-unit dispatch, destination receipt, and reconciliation.

provincial_admin.mission: See province-level risk without losing facility accountability, then focus teams on the few exceptions that need coordinated action.
provincial_admin.handoff: Facilities retain clinical custody; provincial visibility supports escalation, governance, and evidence-based allocation.

emergency_controller.mission: Stress-test the network, compare response levers, and coordinate incidents without confusing preparedness modelling with a live declaration.
emergency_controller.handoff: Simulation is read-only. Live recommendations still pass through permissioned declaration, approval, dispatch, and receipt controls.

system_admin.mission: Keep trusted data, integrations, accounts, and operational evidence available without stepping around clinical role boundaries.
system_admin.handoff: Administrators maintain the platform; clinical and logistics decisions remain with their authorized operational roles.

donor_lookup.title: Find or register the donor
donor_lookup.body: Search before creating a record, confirm identity, and review eligibility or recall status.

screen_donor.title: Complete donor screening
screen_donor.body: Record measurements and history; the rules explain acceptance, temporary deferral, or required review.

collection.title: Record the collection
collection.body: Create the labelled bag at draw time and hand it to the laboratory as quarantined stock.

lab_queue.title: Clear the laboratory queue
lab_queue.body: Work oldest waiting donations first, record controls, and keep testing separate from independent release.

processing.title: Prepare viable components
processing.body: Prioritize the next component window to close and record any timing or technical loss explicitly.

inventory.title: Verify available inventory
inventory.body: Review screening, location, expiry, reservation, and traceability before treating a unit as usable.

requests.title: Review clinical requests
requests.body: Prioritize urgency, confirm patient requirements, and follow crossmatch, issue, and outcome to closure.

command.title: Read the Command Centre
command.body: Start with the exceptions needing a decision, then open the evidence behind shortage, expiry, and transfer signals.

expiry.title: Rescue expiring stock
expiry.body: Act from last safe dispatch time, preserve reserve floors, and keep unrescuable units visible.

transfers.title: Review governed transfers
transfers.body: Approve or reject the recommendation, then follow named units through dispatch, receipt, and reconciliation.

alerts.title: Own operational alerts
alerts.body: Acknowledge the condition, inspect its evidence, assign responsibility, and resolve it with an accountable note.

simulator.title: Run a preparedness scenario
simulator.body: Use a reproducible seed, compare interventions, and keep simulation distinct from a live declaration.

data.title: Check data and integrations
data.body: Review feed health, quarantined rows, reconciliation, provenance, and scoped API access before trusting downstream numbers.

showcase.title: Guided Demonstration
showcase.headline: One blood network. Every decision connected.
showcase.intro: Follow a measured four-minute path from donor and patient operations to forecasting, governed stock movement, emergency response and integration evidence. Every number below comes from the working tenant-scoped system.
showcase.story_help: Each chapter opens the real working surface and states the evidence to prove.
showcase.chapter_operations_body: Show that this is a complete blood-bank system: donor screening, collection, testing, component preparation, inventory, requests, crossmatch, issue and outcome all share one traceable record.
showcase.chapter_operations_proof: Open a unit or request and follow its custody and clinical state rather than describing a disconnected dashboard.
showcase.chapter_intelligence: Move from stock to predictive action
showcase.chapter_intelligence_body: Use the morning command view to connect current cover, P10/P50/P90 demand, shortage risk and expiry deadlines to a responsible facility and unit.
showcase.chapter_intelligence_proof: Expose the measured backtest, baseline comparison, uncertainty coverage and data freshness beside the recommendation.
showcase.chapter_transfer: Turn a recommendation into accountable custody
showcase.chapter_transfer_body: Review a FEFO manifest, preserve reserve floors, approve with a named actor, dispatch, track, receive and reconcile individual units.
showcase.chapter_transfer_proof: No recommendation moves stock by itself; approval and receipt are separate audited transactions.
showcase.chapter_emergency: Stress-test the network before an incident
showcase.chapter_emergency_body: Run a deterministic 1,000-iteration emergency scenario, compare interventions and produce governed transfer recommendations without confusing a drill with a live declaration.
showcase.chapter_emergency_proof: The same seed reproduces the result and every real-world action still requires authorization.
showcase.chapter_governance_body: Show CSV, FHIR and HL7 entering one validation, quarantine, provenance and reconciliation contract, plus tenant-scoped APIs and revocable keys.
showcase.chapter_governance_proof: Invalid rows never enter clinical tables, while accepted records retain their source and audit history.
showcase.group_noise_note: Blood-group daily WAPE is {wape}% against a {floor}% estimated noise floor; the decision-grain metric is shown above so aggregation never hides uncertainty.
showcase.no_quality: No measured forecast run is available yet.
showcase.live_proof_help: These values are queried at page load from the signed-in organization; they are not presentation fixtures.

cc.quality_honesty: Targets are fixed in the specification. Missed gates remain visible and recommendations still require human review.

cc.map_legend: Larger circles hold more units. Red indicates the facility has critical series.

fc.subtitle: Requested units per day, with an 80% prediction interval
fc.no_breach: Projected to stay above the reserve floor across the horizon.
fc.noise_floor_help: Estimated lower bound on achievable error for this series. WAPE is only interpretable against it.

ex.title: Expiry Rescue
ex.subtitle: 96% of measured blood wastage in Pakistan is expiry. Expiry is predictable.
ex.prevention_help: Structural fixes, not just today's rescue.
ex.build_plan: Build rescue plan for all Act now units
ex.no_units: No units are currently at risk of expiry in this scope.
ex.unrescuable_explain: These units are at risk and cannot be saved. The reason is stated for each — hiding them would overstate what the network can do.
ex.group_by_destination: Grouped by destination for batch dispatch
ex.decision_queue: Rescue decisions, not just an expiry list
ex.flow_title: How rescue decisions become safe movements
ex.flow_help: Use this queue to identify risk, then complete the accountable decision and custody workflow in Transfer Plans.
ex.flow_identify_help: Rabta ranks units by expiry risk, demand and the safe dispatch window.
ex.flow_review_help: Check the named bags, destination, compatibility, route and cold-chain limits.
ex.flow_decide_help: An authorized reviewer makes and records the accountable decision.
ex.flow_execute_help: Custody hand-off and receiving reconciliation update both facilities.
ex.flow_boundary: This page prioritizes risk; it never approves or moves stock. Open the linked transfer to make a decision.
ex.not_planned_help: No active transfer contains this unit yet. Open its evidence to investigate why.
ex.rescuable_help: has a safe destination and dispatch window
ex.unrescuable_help: visible so capability is not overstated
ex.queue_help: Every recommendation states why, where and by when.
ex.reason_pending: The engine did not store a reason for this unit.
ex.reason_rescue: Expires in {hours} hours. {destination}, {minutes} minutes away, has projected demand before expiry.
ex.reason_planned: At {probability}% expiry risk, this unit is included in transfer {tracking} to {destination}. Open the governed record to review the network rationale and make the decision.
ex.reason_no_route: Expires in {hours} hours, but no destination currently satisfies need, transport and usable-arrival constraints.
ex.no_safe_destination: No destination meets need, time and transport constraints.
ex.timeline_help: Expiry volume split between projected use and residual risk.
ex.timeline_empty: No scored unit expires inside the next 14 days.
ex.prevention_suggestion: {units} {component} {group} units repeatedly have no rescue path. Review the standing allocation and collection target.
ex.no_prevention_help: No component–group series has three or more unrescuable units in this scope.
ex.no_units_help: Try a wider facility scope or clear the filters.
ex.human_approval_notice: These are recommendations only. Rabta-e-Hayat never authorizes movement of blood without an accountable human approval and a complete custody trail.

tr.title: Transfer Plans
tr.unmet_explain: Redistribution cannot create units. What remains is a collection-capacity finding.
tr.optimality_not_proved: best plan found within the time limit
tr.expand_row: Expand for units, compatibility path and cold chain
tr.scenario_help: Change the priorities and re-solve. The whole plan restructures.
tr.reject_reason_required: A structured reason is required. Rejection reasons feed optimizer weight tuning.
tr.rejected_toast: Transfer rejected. Reason recorded for weight tuning.
tr.no_plan: No transfer plan has been generated yet.
tr.modify_help: Reducing the quantity keeps the earliest-expiring feasible units. Increasing it requires a fresh solve.
tr.workspace_subtitle: Approve recommendations, reserve physical bags, dispatch under custody, and reconcile every unit at receipt.
tr.search_placeholder: Facility, tracking code, component or group
tr.no_history_help: History appears here after the optimizer generates a replacement plan; executed custody records are never deleted.
tr.execution_help: One row per component and compatibility path; every row has its own accountable approval and unit manifest.
tr.no_matching_help: Clear a filter or search a different facility, component or tracking code.
tr.governance_notice: A recommendation never moves inventory. Approval reserves named units; confirmed departure marks them in transit; only receiving reconciliation can make accepted units available at the destination.
tr.decision_evidence_help: The optimizer's compatibility path, counterfactual impact and physical feasibility remain visible at the human gate.
tr.rationale_fallback: Selected by the constrained optimizer from current shortage, expiry, reserve, compatibility, capacity and transport evidence.
tr.derived_rationale: Move {units} units of {component} {donor} from {source} to {destination} ({minutes} min) to answer {recipient} demand. Compatibility: {donor} → {recipient} ({compatibility}). Physical bags are FEFO-selected; earliest expiry {expiry}.
tr.manifest_help: Named bags, FEFO ordered. The declared quantity cannot diverge from this manifest.
tr.manifest_unavailable_help: This recommendation cannot be approved until physical units are assigned.
tr.approval_gate_help: Clinical constraints are revalidated at approval; stale recommendations are refused.
tr.approve_confirmation: Reserve all {units} named units and authorize this movement. The action and actor will be written to the audit trail.
tr.modified_toast: Transfer quantity reduced. FEFO manifest and impact updated.
tr.dispatched_toast: Custody record sealed. Transfer is ready for confirmed departure.
tr.departed_toast: Departure confirmed. Manifest is now in transit.
tr.received_toast: Receipt reconciled. Destination inventory and exceptions were updated unit by unit.
tr.cancelled_toast: Movement cancelled. Reserved units were released back to source inventory.
tr.dispatch_help: Capture the person, validated container, seal, courier and departure temperature before hand-off.
tr.departure_help: Courier: {courier} · seal: {seal}. This changes every reserved bag to in transit.
tr.receipt_help: Mark what physically arrived and what is acceptable. Unchecked manifest units become missing-in-transit exceptions.
tr.discrepancy_placeholder: Package condition, missing unit inquiry, courier statement…
tr.exception_quarantine_notice: An out-of-range temperature, broken/missing seal, or expired arrival quarantines every received unit automatically. No override is available on this screen.

sim.title: Emergency Simulator
sim.subtitle: Stress-test the network against a mass-casualty event before it happens.
sim.determinism_note: The same seed always produces the same result.
sim.requirement_planning_help: Sums each component-group cell's own P95. Quantiles are not additive, so this exceeds the Monte Carlo P95 by construction — but a surplus of one group does not answer a shortfall in another, so this is the figure to procure against.
sim.no_crossover: No shortfall within the modelled window
sim.not_run: Configure a scenario and run the simulation to see results.

auth.locked: Too many failed attempts. This account is locked for {minutes} minutes.
auth.inactive: This account has been deactivated. Contact your organization administrator.
auth.session_expired: Your session timed out after 30 minutes of inactivity. Please sign in again.
auth.demo_hint: Every account below uses the password shown. Each belongs to a different organization, so you can see the isolation and the network layer from both sides.
auth.session_policy: Sessions end after 30 minutes of inactivity. Six failed attempts lock the account for 15 minutes.
auth.facility_scope_body: Donors, collection, laboratory, processing, inventory, requests and issue
auth.organization_scope_body: Consolidated stock across your hospitals and a governed shared donor pool
auth.network_scope_body: Consent-based availability and transfers between organizations
auth.click_account_hint: Select a row to fill the sign-in form.
auth.seed_accounts_suffix: to create the demonstration organizations and users.
auth.change_password_help: Choose a new password and sign out any other active sessions.
auth.change_password_help_forced: An administrator issued a temporary password. Replace it before opening operational records.

auth.passwords_do_not_match: The new passwords do not match.

req.title: Clinical Requests
req.patient_ref_help: Use the hospital's stable pseudonymous reference; do not enter a patient name.
req.patient_privacy_note: Patient identity remains in the hospital system. Rabta-e-Hayat stores only the episode reference needed for safe issue and traceability.
req.requirement_note: Urgency and required-by time control queue order. Compatibility and available stock still determine which unit may be issued.
req.could_not_save: The request could not be saved
req.not_found: That clinical request was not found in this facility.
req.search_placeholder: Request code, episode reference, or ward
req.empty_body: Change the filters or create a clinical request when blood is required.
req.compatible_stock_help: Group-compatible, screening-passed stock ordered by compatibility preference and first expiry first out.
req.group_needed_for_crossmatch: Record the patient blood group before selecting stock for crossmatch.
req.emergency_unknown_group_notice: The patient group is not yet known. Only stock enabled by the configurable emergency-release policy is shown.
req.crossmatch_released: Crossmatched unit released to available stock.
req.crossmatch_history_help: Every result, repeat, allocation, and release remains linked to this requirement.
req.emergency_issue_warning: Exception pathway: this unit will leave controlled inventory before crossmatch completion. Authorization and acknowledgement are permanently audited.
req.emergency_acknowledgement: I confirm the clinical team requested release before crossmatch completion and accepts the configured emergency-release protocol.
req.emergency_unit_issued: Emergency unit released and custody recorded.
req.no_compatible_stock: No compatible stock is currently available
req.no_compatible_stock_help: Review network availability or shortage actions; incompatible stock is never presented as ordinary stock.
req.no_crossmatches_help: Choose a compatible candidate to begin the laboratory allocation.
req.issue_outcomes_help: An issue remains open until a transfusion outcome or return is recorded.
req.not_returned_warning: This closes custody as an incident and permanently removes the unit from usable inventory. Use only after checking the ward and transfusion record.
req.not_returned_saved: Custody incident recorded and unit removed from usable stock.
req.cold_chain_confirm: I verified that the cold chain remained intact.
req.no_issues_help: A valid compatible crossmatch is required before issue.
req.emergency_no_issues_help: Use the governed emergency-release action above, or record the patient group and complete crossmatching.
req.action_timeline_help: A time-ordered audit trail of every decision and custody event for this request.
req.no_timeline_help: The request audit trail will appear here.
req.event_unit_issued: Unit issued and custody handed over
req.finalise_help: Close a completed or clinically discontinued requirement. Cancellation is only available before any unit is issued.
req.partial_close_reason: Reason required when closing before full fulfilment
req.cancelled: Clinical request cancelled and allocations released.

sim.title: Emergency Digital Twin
sim.subtitle: Model casualty-driven demand, infrastructure disruption and interventions before making an accountable live declaration.
sim.mode_banner_help: Preparedness results do not change inventory, contact donors or authorize transport.
sim.builder_help: Clinical assumptions, infrastructure effects and response levers are explicit and reviewable.
sim.infrastructure_help: Affected receiving capacity, stock access and road travel are applied inside the model.
sim.view_only: Your role can review prepared results but cannot run or declare a scenario.
sim.no_runs_help: Run a governed scenario to create the first reproducible baseline.
sim.no_result_help: Set the incident, casualty mix and infrastructure conditions, then run the digital twin.
sim.comparison_complete: Intervention comparison completed with the baseline seed.
sim.same_seed_help: Only response levers changed; casualty randomness is held constant.
sim.requirement_mix: Requirement by component and recipient group
sim.requirement_help: Conservative cell-level P95; incompatible surpluses are never netted across groups.
sim.timeline_help: Cumulative P95 demand under the selected onset profile.
sim.transfer_help: Nearest feasible, consented routes with component transport limits enforced.
sim.no_transfers_help: Local intervention stock covers every placed requirement in this run.
sim.brief_help: Bilingual deterministic narrative generated only from the result facts shown above.
sim.compare_help: Re-run against the exact baseline seed so the delta reflects policy, not random variation.
sim.declare_warning: This creates a live incident, a critical alert and FEFO physical-unit recommendations. Inventory still does not move until each source approves.
sim.live_declared: Live emergency declared. Governed recommendations are ready; no inventory moved automatically.
sim.resolution_note: How did the live response end?
sim.live_resolved: Live emergency resolved and its surge alert closed.

alerts.title: Operational Alerts
alerts.subtitle: One record per operational condition, with deduplication, ownership, escalation and evidence-based resolution.
alerts.queue_help: New evidence updates an existing condition instead of creating alert noise.
alerts.ack_note: What have you verified or started?
alerts.resolve_reason: What evidence shows this is resolved?
alerts.resolved: Alert resolved with an auditable reason.
alerts.no_alerts_help: Refresh from operational evidence or broaden the filters.
alerts.governance_notice: Alerts never move inventory or contact donors by themselves. Every acknowledgement and resolution is attributable and audited.

data.title: Data & Integrations
data.hero_title: Bring every blood bank into one trusted data contract
data.hero_body: Manual CSV, FHIR R4, HL7 v2 and the synthetic feed all pass through the same tenant boundary, validation rules, quarantine queue and provenance ledger. Nothing reaches operational stock or forecasting until an accountable user commits valid rows.
data.contract_archive_body: Hash and retain the exact payload before parsing.
data.contract_validate_body: Schema, references, clinical plausibility and duplicates.
data.contract_commit_body: Only valid rows enter domain tables; exceptions stay visible.
data.manual_upload_hint: A first-class path for a facility without an integration team.
data.csv_limits: UTF-8 CSV · maximum 5 MB and 10,000 data rows
data.identity_guard_body: Patient names, donor names, CNICs, phones and addresses are refused before the payload is stored.
data.adapter_manual_body: Automatic column mapping, live row validation and machine-readable error export.
data.adapter_fhir_body: BiologicallyDerivedProduct and blood-transfusion ServiceRequest preview support.
data.adapter_hl7_body: Documented ORM and blood-product implementation-guide segments for vendor mapping.
data.adapter_simulated_body: The demo generator implements the same interface as a production feed.
data.feed_status_hint: Health, freshness and exception counts remain visible even when a feed is stale.
data.no_facilities_body: Onboard a facility before configuring a feed.
data.ingestion_history_hint: Checksums, row counts, duration and outcomes form the replay ledger.
data.no_imports_body: Upload a template or send a preview through API v1.
data.reconciliation_hint: Clinical conflicts and statistical outliers stay assigned until somebody records the resolution.
data.reconciled_body: The current integration ledger reconciles cleanly.
data.issue_resolved: Reconciliation issue resolved with an audit note.
data.api_clients_hint: Hashed machine credentials with explicit tenant, facility and capability scope.
data.key_once: Copy this secret now. Rabta stores only its hash and will not show it again.
data.no_api_clients: No machine clients have been issued.
data.least_privilege: Start with the smallest access the source needs.
data.facility_scope_hint: Select none to permit every current facility in this organization.
data.idempotent_update: same source reference; no duplicate insert
data.column_mapping_hint: Map source headers to the canonical contract, then re-run every rule.
data.remap_revalidates: Saving replaces the preview rows and recalculates quarantine evidence.
data.mapping_saved: Column mapping saved and the batch was revalidated.
data.commit_hint: This is the first point where domain data can change.
data.partial_commit_body: {count} exception rows remain quarantined or rejected and will be skipped.
data.validation_clean_body: Every row is valid or an idempotent source match.
data.commit_effect_domain: create or safely update canonical inventory/demand records;
data.commit_effect_provenance: link every committed row to its source, checksum and batch;
data.commit_effect_skips: leave every exception outside operational and forecasting tables.
data.commit_phrase_error: Type COMMIT VALID ROWS exactly to continue.
data.commit_success: Import committed: {count} valid or idempotent rows processed.
data.import_committed_body: {count} rows were processed by {actor}; provenance and the raw archive are retained.
data.validation_preview_hint: The canonical values and exact rule evidence for every source row.
data.no_rows_body: Revalidate the source mapping to rebuild the preview.
data.provenance_guarantee_body: a committed entity can be traced to the source mode, external reference, payload hash, first/last observation, version count and raw archived batch.
data.error_datetime_invalid: The date must use ISO 8601 or YYYYMMDD format.
data.error_integer_invalid: The value must be a whole number.
data.error_integer_range: The number is outside the clinically plausible range.
data.error_too_long: The value exceeds the permitted length.
data.error_component_unknown: The component is not present in controlled reference data.
data.error_blood_group_unknown: The blood group is not one of the eight ABO/Rh groups.
data.error_expiry_order: Expiry must be later than collection.
data.error_shelf_life_implausible: The declared shelf life exceeds policy by more than ten percent.
data.error_status_invalid: The supplied unit status is not supported.
data.error_screening_invalid: The supplied screening status is not supported.
data.error_unscreened_usable_stock: Stock cannot be usable until screening has passed.
data.error_duplicate_in_file: The source reference appears more than once in this payload.
data.error_din_collision: This DIN already identifies another physical unit.
data.error_existing_unit_conflict: The source conflicts with the existing physical unit and requires reconciliation.
data.error_no_compatible_storage: No active, in-range storage location can safely hold this unit.

ops.nothing_expiring_body: No available unit at this facility reaches expiry inside the selected window.

ops.donor_left_reason: Donor left before the screening was completed.
ops.deferral_privacy_note: This summary shows counts only. Named deferral findings remain restricted clinical information.
ops.nobody_deferred_body: Every donor screened at this session was accepted.
ops.find_donor_body: Search by name, donor code, phone, or the last four CNIC digits.
ops.find_donor_camp_body: At an outreach session, register a new donor here without sending them to another form.
ops.find_donor_placeholder: Name, code, phone or CNIC last four
ops.no_donor_match_body: Check the spelling or register this donor below.
ops.register_donor_from_session_body: Start from an open collection session so registration, screening, the labelled bag, and the laboratory hand-off stay linked in one traceable workflow.
ops.register_donor_body: Capture only what screening requires. Contact preferences can be completed from the donor record later.
ops.contact_consent: This donor consents to being contacted for future donations
ops.cnic_privacy_note: The CNIC is retained as a one-way hash plus its last four digits, enabling later matching without exposing the full number.
ops.needs_signoff_hint: The approved clinical sources disagree on this rule
ops.conditional_deferral_help: No automatic end date; this lifts when the finding resolves.
ops.permanent_deferral_help: Permanent. This donor will not become eligible again.
ops.measurements_help: Haemoglobin and weight determine eligibility and the permitted collection volume. Save to refresh the verdict.
ops.history_help: {count} questions apply to this donor. Every yes answer is assessed against the configured deferral rules.
ops.complete_deferred_help: Completing records the deferral and updates the donor register.
ops.complete_accepted_help: Completing locks this screening record; it cannot be edited afterwards.
ops.collection_help: The bag record is created at draw time as quarantined stock. It is not issuable or counted as available until laboratory release.
ops.permitted_volume: This donor's weight permits {volume} ml. The service will reject any larger recorded collection.
ops.quarantine_pending_lab: Units from this bag remain quarantined and unavailable until laboratory release.
ops.deferred_recorded: The deferral is recorded and the donor no longer appears as eligible.
ops.deferred_signoff_queue: Because approved sources disagree, this finding is queued for clinical review rather than settled by a default.
ops.no_consent_hint: This donor did not consent to contact
ops.eligibility_freshness_note: Eligibility is calculated now from the donation interval, age and active deferrals. Chair-side haemoglobin, weight and vitals are always measured afresh.
ops.no_donor_results_body: Try a shorter term or reset the filters to see the whole register.
ops.state_permanent_detail: Not eligible to donate; this deferral does not expire.
ops.state_awaiting_confirmation_detail: A pending clinical result must be resolved before this donor can be accepted.
ops.state_conditional_detail: No automatic end date; reassessment is required before acceptance.
ops.state_eligible_detail: Clear on interval, age and deferrals. Vitals are checked at the chair.
ops.conditional_review_help: Conditional; there is no automatic end date. Clinical review is required before acceptance.
ops.verification_gap: Some results were not independently verified because no second technologist was available.
ops.no_donations_body: This history may predate go-live, or the donor has registered but not yet donated.
ops.hb_method_note: Haemoglobin is measured using the configured copper-sulphate method with a 12.5 g/dL threshold.
ops.no_screenings_body: This donor has not been screened at this facility.
ops.recall_intro: Every recorded unit donated by this donor and its current location or outcome.
ops.group_unconfirmed_hint: Recorded but not confirmed by a second blood grouping
ops.recoverable_body: can be removed from available stock now
ops.expired_discarded_body: already off the shelf; no recovery action
ops.legacy_untraceable: {count} earlier donations cannot be traced here
ops.legacy_untraceable_body: The donor register records {lifetime} lifetime donations, while {digital} have complete digital unit records. Earlier opening-balance donations must be traced through the paper register.
ops.given_to_patient_body: These units cannot be recovered. Notify each receiving facility and begin patient lookback.
ops.no_units_for_donor: No units on record for this donor
ops.no_units_for_donor_body: This donor has not donated since the system went live.
ops.blocked_two_person_body: you tested these; another person must sign
ops.start_plate_body: One assay per run. Kit lot, expiry and analyser stay attached to every result for recall and audit.
ops.ready_release_help: The panel is complete and clear. A second person verifies release before quarantined bags become issuable stock.
ops.you_tested_this_hint: A second person must verify results entered by you
ops.blocked_visible_note: {count} donations tested by you remain visible so the separation-of-duties queue cannot be overlooked.
ops.nothing_signature_body: Donations appear here after every required assay has a result.
ops.awaiting_results_help: Oldest first. Untested waiting time consumes usable shelf life, especially for platelets.
ops.nothing_waiting_body: Every collected donation at this facility has a complete panel.
ops.plate_invalid_body: Control failure makes every sample result on this plate uninterpretable. Re-run every sample on a new plate; release is blocked.
ops.controls_help: Record positive and negative control performance before entering or releasing sample results.
ops.controls_failure_placeholder: What went wrong with the controls?
ops.reactive_atomic_help: A reactive result atomically discards units, quarantines the donation, defers the donor pending confirmation and raises confirmatory testing.
ops.immutable_result_note: A result is never overwritten. Repeats use a new plate and a new record so reactive evidence cannot disappear.
ops.nothing_recorded_body: Enter results above to populate this plate.
ops.signoff_why_body: These deferral rules have conflicting approved sources. The configured default keeps donors safe, while an authorized clinician resolves each individual case with recorded reasoning.
ops.signoff_governance_body: Both the applied interpretation and the alternative remain visible; neither a silent default nor an unrecorded override can settle the case.
ops.lift_placeholder: Record the clinical reasoning, not only ‘approved’.
ops.uphold_placeholder: Record why the reviewed deferral remains appropriate.
ops.showing_longest: Showing the 12 longest-waiting of {count}; remaining cases appear as these are cleared.
ops.signoff_audit_note: Both outcomes and their reasoning are recorded against the donor, preserving the distinction between reviewed and unreviewed deferrals.
ops.no_signoff_body: No donor at this facility is held by a contested deferral rule.
ops.separations_body: recorded here in the last 30 days
ops.reconstructed_excluded: {count} legacy separations are excluded from measured yield because their expected output was never recorded.
ops.bags_awaiting_help: Ordered by the next component window to close, not simply by bag age. A late bag is not a wasted bag: red cells can remain viable after the platelet window closes.
ops.expired_components: {components} can no longer be produced from this bag; components still inside their window remain usable.
ops.window_loss: Window closed after {hours} hours — recorded as a loss
ops.loss_requires_cause: Every expected component not produced requires a cause so preventable loss can be reduced.
ops.nothing_separate_body: Every released bag at this facility has been processed.
ops.losses_help: Separating timing losses from technical failures makes the improvement action explicit.
ops.signoff_limb_who_2_years_after_cure: WHO — defer 2 years after documented cure
ops.signoff_limb_who_12_months_with_marker_r: WHO — 12 months with marker re-entry testing
ops.signoff_note_syphilis_history: Punjab defers 12 months after treatment; WHO defers permanently because serology cannot distinguish treated from active infection.
ops.signoff_note_tuberculosis: A permanent bar in a high-TB-burden country has a major donor-base cost; WHO reports no published transfusion transmission.
ops.signoff_note_hepatitis_b_history: WHO re-entry needs anti-HBc and anti-HBs testing outside Pakistan's federal minimum panel, so a permanent deferral is defensible.
ops.signoff_note_epilepsy: The provincial source lists epilepsy as both permanent and temporary, creating an internal contradiction.
ops.signoff_note_breastfeeding: The SOP states six months after delivery in one place and twelve months for nursing mothers elsewhere.
ops.signoff_note_typhoid: The sources differ thirteen-fold on the deferral interval after typhoid.
ops.signoff_note_diastolic_floor: This is the strictest reviewed standard and may substantially increase deferrals in a population with prevalent hypertension.
ops.cold_chain_block_hint: Cold-chain breach recorded; this unit cannot be transferred
ops.fefo_note: Ordered by first-expiry-first-out, the sequence in which safe stock must be reviewed and issued.
ops.fefo_showing: Showing the first {shown} of {total} matching units.
ops.no_units_filters_body: Change the filters or reset to see everything this facility holds.
ops.wastage_note: Reactive discards show the screening panel working. Expiry and cold-chain loss are operational failures that can be reduced.
ops.discard_returned_unsuitable: Returned from ward; no longer issuable
ops.storage_window: Last {days} days; one reading every 30 minutes
ops.quarantine_store_help: Untested and reactive stock only; nothing here is issuable.
ops.agitator_help: Continuous agitation is active to protect platelet quality.
ops.breach_trace_note: Open a store to connect every temperature excursion to the units physically exposed at the time.
ops.no_storage: No storage recorded for this facility
ops.no_storage_body: Storage locations and temperature history have not been configured here.
ops.quarantine_store_detail: Untested and reactive stock is segregated here so an unreleased bag cannot be selected from issuable stock.
ops.target_band: Shaded band is the target range ({minimum} to {maximum}°C)
ops.excursion_group_note: Consecutive out-of-range readings are grouped into one event so one equipment failure is not counted many times.
ops.no_excursions: No out-of-range reading in the last {days} days.
ops.units_exposed: Units in this store during excursions
ops.units_exposed_body: Every listed unit was physically inside the store while temperature was out of range and requires an explicit disposition decision.
ops.no_exposed_units: No units were in this store during those excursions.
ops.unit_excursions: {count} out-of-range readings while this unit was stored here
ops.unit_no_excursions: No out-of-range reading since this unit was placed.
ops.no_storage_location: this unit has no recorded storage location
ops.discard_warning: This irreversible action removes the unit from stock and records the actor, reason and shelf life remaining.
ops.discard_reserved_block: This unit is committed to a patient. Release the reservation before discarding it.
ops.already_discarded: Already discarded {date}. A unit can only be discarded once.
ops.separated_unit_block: This parent bag was separated and no longer exists as a unit; its products have their own identifiers.
ops.status_discard_block: A unit that is {status} cannot be discarded.
ops.opening_balance_warning: No donation record precedes this unit. It entered as opening stock at go-live and cannot be traced to a donor.
ops.stage_summary_returned_accepted: Returned and accepted back into stock
ops.stage_summary_custody_exception: Issued unit was not returned or confirmed transfused
ops.no_trace_steps: No traceability steps are recorded for this unit.
ops.reduced_volume_warning: Reduced-volume collection: confirm that the anticoagulant volume matches the planned draw before collection.
ops.malaria_disabled_warning: Malaria screening is disabled; domestic travel exposure must be assessed because Pakistan is malaria-endemic.
ops.screening_accepted_flash: Screening accepted. Record the collection below.
ops.screening_deferred_flash: Donor deferred. The deferral has been recorded and the register updated.
ops.collection_recorded_flash: Collected. {din} is quarantined pending laboratory release.
ops.screening_abandoned_flash: Screening abandoned and recorded as such.
ops.invalid_date_of_birth: That date of birth is not a valid date.
ops.donor_added_flash: {name} was added to the donor register.
ops.invalid_kit_expiry: That kit expiry is not a valid date.
ops.reactive_results_recorded_flash: {recorded} results recorded. {reactive} reactive — those units were discarded, their donors deferred pending confirmation, and confirmatory tests were raised.
ops.controls_invalidated_flash: Plate invalidated. Every sample on it must be re-run; its results cannot be released.
ops.unit_released_flash: {din} released. Its units are now available stock.
ops.confirmed_positive_flash: Confirmed positive. The donor is permanently deferred and should be notified and referred.
ops.not_confirmed_flash: Not confirmed. The donor is deferred pending a repeat test rather than being recorded as infected.
ops.components_shortfall_flash: Separated into {produced} of {expected} expected components. The shortfall is recorded against its cause.
ops.components_separated_flash: Separated into {count} components, now available stock.
ops.deferral_lifted_flash: Deferral lifted and the clinical reasoning recorded.
ops.deferral_upheld_flash: Deferral upheld and the clinical reasoning recorded.
ops.storage_not_at_facility: That storage location is not at this facility.
ops.unit_not_at_facility: That unit is not held at this facility.
ops.unit_discarded_flash: {din} was discarded and removed from the shelf. The reason is recorded against this unit.

release.title: Release acceptance
release.admin_help: Review live release gates, role hand-offs, operating models and the complete UAT chain in one place.
release.read_only: Read-only evidence · no clinical state changes
release.headline: One release dossier for every role, hand-off and operating model.
release.intro: This workspace reads the live synthetic platform and turns the full acceptance contract into a clear sequence. A green gate proves readiness; it never replaces the human decision at a clinical or custody boundary.
release.live_gates_help: Recomputed from this database whenever the page is opened.
release.gate_runtime_help: Configuration, schema and local assets are ready; the CLI dossier adds full integrity verification.
release.gate_synthetic_help: The candidate is explicitly isolated from real donor and patient data.
release.gate_roles_help: Every acceptance identity is active, assigned correctly and ready to sign in.
release.gate_reference_help: All eight blood groups and six governed component families are configured.
release.gate_segregation_help: At least one facility has two active technologists for independent release.
release.gate_intelligence_help: The analytical snapshot is clean and matches the latest source version.
release.gate_modes_help: Standalone, hospital-group, RBC-network and provincial evidence is present.
release.workflow_chain_help: Run in order: each stage creates the accountable hand-off used by the next.
release.delta_collection: Donor, screening, collection, worklist and quarantine counts move once at their real state transition.
release.delta_signoff: The contested queue closes only after an accountable clinical decision and audit event.
release.delta_laboratory: Component yield remains quarantined until a second technologist independently releases a complete panel.
release.delta_patient: Request, FEFO allocation, issue custody, inventory and outcome remain one traceable chain.
release.delta_network: Imports reconcile once; transfer inventory moves only through approval, departure and receipt.
release.delta_emergency: Simulation is non-mutating; declaration creates governed work without silently moving a unit.
release.delta_governance: Province scope, alerts, policy and optimizer actions stay visible, scoped and audited.
release.delta_platform: Users, facilities, integrations and activation respect security boundaries and explicit readiness.
release.automated_evidence: Backed by {count} focused automated test modules
release.role_handoffs_help: The verifier identity is separate because laboratory release requires a second person.
release.operating_modes_help: Reference facilities prove each governance and sharing boundary.
release.mode_standalone_private_proof: Local blood-bank operations work while inventory and contact sharing stay off.
release.mode_standalone_shared_proof: Local ownership remains intact while safe stock signals may join planning.
release.mode_hospital_group_proof: One organization governs multiple facilities with facility-level operational custody.
release.mode_rbc_network_proof: The active RBC owns a same-province spoke network without bypassing movement approval.
release.mode_province_proof: Province oversight aggregates risk while tenant ownership and consent remain enforced.
release.operator_next_help: Use this evidence page first, then the timed showcase and role-specific acceptance script.
release.cli_note: The operator command creates machine-readable release evidence and checks live role routes. Docker build and persistence are a separate required host gate.

ai.title: Rabta AI
ai.hero_title: A governed copilot for blood-supply decisions.
ai.hero_body: Ask questions in plain language, generate operational briefs and understand recommendations without giving AI authority over inventory, patients or policy.
ai.ask_title: Ask about the current operational picture
ai.ask_help: Rabta AI answers only from the safe, role-scoped facts displayed by this platform.
ai.question_blocked: That question contains information Rabta AI is not allowed to process. Remove names, email addresses, phone numbers, CNICs, donor IDs, patient IDs or secrets and try again.
ai.question_placeholder: For example: Which shortages should my team handle first, and why?
ai.no_identifiers_help: Do not enter donor, patient or staff identifiers. Operational names, routes, blood groups and metrics are allowed.
ai.empty_body: Every response is labelled as verified AI, offline fallback or safely blocked.
ai.inline_brief_help: Turn the current shortage, expiry and transfer picture into a concise shift brief.
ai.guardian_help: These controls keep AI aware of input quality before it explains demand risk.
ai.role_scope_help: Only data permitted for your role and selected facility scope is supplied to AI.
ai.safety_facts: Every number and facility name is checked against the supplied facts.
ai.safety_privacy: Direct identities, contact details, credentials and raw prompts are excluded from provider calls and logs.
ai.safety_human: AI may explain or recommend; only an authorised person can approve, release, allocate or transfer.
ai.safety_offline: If Qwen is unavailable or fails validation, a deterministic evidence-based answer is shown instead.
ai.optimizer_help: Ask Qwen to explain scoped transfer feedback and configured weights. It cannot change policy or run the optimizer.
ai.no_recent: No AI interactions in this scope yet.
ai.admin_hero: Qwen is contained behind one auditable decision boundary.
ai.admin_body: Monitor availability, cost, validation and fallbacks without exposing prompts or granting AI operational authority.
ai.audit_help: Hashes, validation outcomes, cost and scope are retained; raw questions and prompts are not.
ai.no_raw_prompts: No raw prompts or questions are stored
ai.identities_blocked: Direct identities and secrets are blocked
ai.numbers_validated: Numbers and facility names must trace to source facts
ai.human_gate_enforced: Clinical, custody and policy actions remain human-gated
